title: refactor(metadata-protocol): generate the protocol.ts section split with a deterministic codemod
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB7J3TmFTYMYQrfpye6GQNg9)_

Part of #29985

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：新增 codemod `scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs`，按 ruling E（E1 host 模式）把 `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` 的 61/284 个方法体移入 9 个分节模块，类上只留签名、docblock 和一行 stub。生成文件未手改。按裁决 6597555122 第 3 点，8 个按路径读 `protocol.ts` 的普查测试和 `check-durability-degradation-log-level` 跟随代码读新模块（`host.` 与 `this.` 同义），ADR 锚点为 3 个接收受管代码的模块各加一条。
- 为什么改：#29465 大文件拆分的 Phase 0，在试点 #29598 之后做 `protocol.ts`。
- 风险与回滚：纯搬移。61/61 方法体逐字节相同；撤销拆分逐字节还原 base 的 `protocol.ts` 和 `protocol-host.ts`（只剩 80 个仅被移出方法体读的 import，证明从 head 重新推出这次修剪）。测试计数 base 22,339 → head 22,340（多 1 条非空检查），门禁读数 base = head，打包 `.d.ts` 按 6441032442 B 第二归一化相等。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：① 下方「按路径读 `protocol.ts` 的读者」表；② codemod 的 `STAY_REASONS`（尤其 `inferred-return-type`，`.d.ts` 对比抓到过它）；③ `check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs` 的两处 host 调用改动和 3 条自测。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` 后运行 `node scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs --verify --base 9049be26`，预期 `61/61 moved bodies restore to the base body exactly`、`23135 -> 15318 lines`，退出码 0；`node scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs --self-test` 42 例通过。
- 需要你做的：一个读数待定：试点的 13,000 行门槛这里没有达到（15,318 行），见下方「未达到的读数」。超过 3,000 行，需您批准后在您定的窗口落地；本 PR 保持草稿。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- **`scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs`** (new): plans, writes and proves the split. It reuses `packages/metadata-protocol/scripts/host-split.mjs` (E1's rewrite set: `this.x` → `host.x`, a private static → `host.x`) for every move, so a moved function has the shape of the 87 existing `protocol-*.ts` modules.
  - Sections are named by their first member (`SECTION_ANCHORS`, after #25467's section table); the five sections the hand series already emptied write no module.
  - A method stays when moving it would change what the published `.d.ts` says, what a by-path reader sees, or when the move cannot be undone byte for byte. Measured on this file (a method can carry several): already-moved 190, no-yield 18, inferred-return-type 8, closed-set 4, name-taken 3, no-host-read 2, host-entry-predicate 1.
  - Three rules were found by building the output, not by reading it:
    - `inferred-return-type` (the pilot's rule, back): without it `getDiscovery`'s printed return type lost the `@deprecated` docblock on `apiName`.
    - `no-host-read`: a body that reads no member would leave `host` unread (`noUnusedParameters`).
    - `host-entry-predicate`: a forwarding closure drops a type predicate (TS2322).
  - The imports only the moved bodies read are pruned from `protocol.ts` (`noUnusedLocals`); a JSDoc `{@link X}` counts as a read, as tsc counts it. The proof recomputes the prune from the head's own references.
  - `--self-test`: 42 cases in 6 pinned batteries, each proof fed an input it must refuse.
- **The generated split**: `--write` on base `9049be26`, unedited. `protocol.ts` and `protocol-host.ts` change; new: `protocol-class-head.ts`, `protocol-discovery-and-bases.ts`, `protocol-search-and-cache.ts`, `protocol-write-gates.ts`, `protocol-registry-hydration.ts`, `protocol-save.ts`, `protocol-history-and-publish.ts`, `protocol-package-commits.ts`, `protocol-diff-delete-load.ts`. Nothing re-exports them.
- **Readers widened** (ruling 6597555122 point 3). These migrate path readers; they are not edits of generated output.
- **`scripts/check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs`**:
  - A moved body's `host.guard(error)` reaches the class's guard through the HOST CALL rule `isReadCall` already follows.
  - A `host.x()` call resolves to the class member `x` first, even when the module declares `x` itself (that member's own moved body, whose extra `host` parameter failed the arity check and dropped `rollbackToPackageCommit`'s seam).
  - `FAILURE_PROPAGATION_SITES` keys `migrateStoredMetadata` and `duplicatePackage` by their new modules.
  - Three new self-test rows; the read-seam floor goes 67 → 70.
- **`scripts/adr-anchors/`**: three new entries. `protocol-registry-hydration.ts` gets ADR-0029 and ADR-0126, `protocol-diff-delete-load.ts` gets ADR-0029, and `protocol-save.ts` gets ADR-0005 and ADR-0087. Each carries the host entry's own invariant paragraphs, in the pilot's shape. The host entry stays.

## Verification

| Reading | Base `9049be26` | Head |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `protocol.ts` lines | 23,135 | **15,318** (8,207 body lines out, 244 stub lines in) |
| Byte-identity | | 61/61 bodies identical; host-split check 61/61 (366 member, 41 private static, 0 constructor rewrites); undo rebuilds both base files |
| Determinism | | output tree sha256 `af32bb253715742dca426de0417e7d3ccf91ba461c4b69637e2289756cdd6916` on two runs; regenerating on base reproduces the committed tree with zero diff |
| metadata-protocol `typecheck` | exit 0 | exit 0 |
| metadata-protocol `test` | 312 files, 22,339 passed, 26 skipped | 312 files, 22,340 passed, 26 skipped (+1: the reconcile census's non-vacuity row) |
| `check:durability-log-level` | 51 seams (9 propagating), 102 read seams (13 discriminated) | the same |
| core / objectql / spec `test:repo` | | 94, 5, 1,524 passed |
| `pnpm lint` | | exit 0 |
| `dispatch-gates --commands` at head `32c7bc04` | | 73 derived, 73 run, every exit 0; `--ran`: 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN |

### `.d.ts`: ruling 6441032442 item 1, second normalisation

The reading uses the dtsnorm reader over the built `dist/` of base and head (`index.d.ts`, `index.d.cts`).

| Reading | `index.d.ts` | `index.d.cts` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| raw | differs (one union's member order, in `getDiscovery`'s printed type) | differs (the same) |
| union order (6348891160 item 1) | equal | equal |
| second normalisation | equal | equal |
| declared surface | equal | equal |

A positive control plants a `private` → public change and is caught (normalised and surface both differ). On the previous generation, which had no `inferred-return-type` rule, the same reading refused the split.

### Readers of `protocol.ts` by path

| Reader | Now |
|:--|:--|
| `protocol.recovery-doors-mutation-projector.test.ts`, `protocol.recovery-doors-emit-mutation.test.ts` | counts over `protocol.ts` plus every split module, `(this\|host).`; the receive-path body is read in `protocol-class-head.ts` |
| `protocol.object-registry-write-through-spelling.test.ts` | caller sets and the `'objects'` scan over every split module |
| `protocol.register-item-call-sites.test.ts` | every split module; moved sites keyed by `file` |
| `protocol.lookup-artifact-item-call-sites.test.ts` | already read every module; ten rows gain `file` |
| `protocol.read-verb-canonical-fold.test.ts` | a wrapper's moved body is followed; the signature is read off the class member |
| `protocol.view-expansion-reconcile-call-sites.test.ts` | `protocol.ts` plus the codemod's modules (see Findings) |
| `protocol.hydrate-overlay-canonical-type.test.ts` | the assert is read in `protocol-registry-hydration.ts` |
| `check-durability-degradation-log-level` | see above; base = head |
| ADR anchors | three entries; `check:adr-anchors` exit 0 |
| `protocol.query-transport-dialect.test.ts`, core `second-object-read-exposure` pin, objectql `core-boundary` ratchet, spec liveness / absence pins, `check-filter-alias-parity`, `check-nul-bytes`, `check-system-context-census` | unchanged (their text stayed in `protocol.ts`, or they read the directory) |

Every widened census was ablated once: a moved call renamed, an `await` dropped, a fold argument changed, or an assert code changed. Each one fails at head. A one-character hand edit in `protocol-save.ts` makes `--verify` exit 1.

### Not met: the line bar

`protocol.ts` ends at 15,318 lines, against the 13,000 that ruling 6591753301 item 3 set for the pilot and carried to the next three files. What is left is mostly docblocks and signatures that stay on the class by E1's design: the `.d.ts` prints them. Another 190 methods are already stubs from the hand series. Reaching 13,000 needs a decision the codemod cannot make, such as moving the docblocks, or a different decomposition. It is raised with the seat and is not hand-cut here.

### Findings outside this PR

`protocol-packageless-overlay-migration.ts` (hand series) calls `repository.delete(` on `sys_metadata`. That call is outside the #23198 stored-row census, which reads only the `repo.` spelling. Widening the census to every module would have turned it red, so the census reads the codemod's modules and the hand-series module stays outside, as before. This was reported to the seat.
